text: dsh-greet 是一个面向 DSH 的轻量工具插件：它通过 bundle patch 将 greet 插件加入 profile，并在工具注册表中提供 greet(name) 调用。agent 可传入一个必填姓名，工具返回对应的英文问候语，例如 Hello, Ada!。适合希望让 DSH agent 按姓名生成简单问候的场景。插件不要求额外 API 密钥或外部账号。

dsh-greet adds a greet tool to DSH profiles through a bundle patch. The entry registers greet(name), which accepts a required name from the agent and returns an English greeting such as “Hello, Ada!”. It suits simple name-based greetings and needs no API key or external account.
想让 DSH agent 能根据我给的名字生成一句问候。
给 DSH 加一个可由 agent 调用、输入姓名并返回问候语的工具。
dsh-greet 的功能「姓名问候」：注册 greet 工具，agent 调用时提供必填姓名，工具返回 “Hello, 姓名!” 文本结果。

dsh-greet README · dsh-greet：A minimal [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) plugin that registers a `greet` tool. Everything in dsh is a plugin; this repository shows the smallest complete bundle you can publish and install.

dsh-greet README · Features：- Registers a `greet` tool callable by the agent: `greet(name)` → `Hello, <name>!`
- No build step: plain JavaScript, installs straight from GitHub.

dsh-greet README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:HDylanYueH/dsh-greet
```

Then restart the profile:

```sh
dsh --profile web
```

Ask the agent: *"Use the greet tool to greet Ada."* The model can call `greet` and receives `Hello, Ada!` as the tool result.

dsh-greet README · Layout：```
dsh-greet/
├── package.json       # declares dsh.bundle (patch: ./cordis.patch.yml)
├── cordis.patch.yml   # the layer applied when a profile lists this bundle
└── index.js           # the Cordis plugin (name / inject / apply)

dsh-greet README · Remove：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-greet
```
